messages:
alex: kicking off eu-west canary for embed-service v2.14 at 30% traffic, running preflight checks now

deploy-bot: Automated: release=v2.14 stage=canary region=eu-west traffic=30% commit=fa3b1c preflight=[metrics,traces,kvcache]

maya: loading Watchtower panel -> https://dash.redwood.ai/watchtower/eu-west span=15m

jamal: heads-up: embed-route p95 climbed from ~110ms to ~410ms over past 6mins

lina: proxy 502s ticked up slightly, sampling a few traces to correlate

srebot: ALERT: slo.embed-route.p95 breached warning threshold (slo-embed-95). routing alerts to thread.

alex: freeze ramp at 30%. check prefix cache hitrate and kvcache evictions. don't escalate yet, just gather data

maya: kvcache evictions spike at 20:42, prefix-hit fell 70% -> 54% during canary window

jamal: traces show a subset of requests hitting quantize-v2 codepath with longer contexts; some pods show memory pressure and retry loops

lina: thinking pin back to v2.13 for canary only to stop the churn while we dig into quantize-v2

alex: agree. plan: pin canary to v2.13, keep traffic at 30% for 30m, mute the SRE alert for that window. who can run the pin?

maya: i'll apply the pin now

```bash
deployctl pin --service embed-service --version v2.13 --scope canary
```

deploy-bot: Pin request accepted. Applying: service=embed-service pin=v2.13 scope=canary. propagation_estimate=20s

ops-runbook: Runbook snippet: If p95 > 300ms AND 5xx_delta > 0.2% -> hold ramp + pin to previous stable version. see https://runbooks.redwood.ai/deploys/canary-pin

srebot: Temporarily suppressing slo-embed-95 alerts for 12m to avoid noise during remediation.

maya: pin is live. routing shows canary shards on v2.13 now. triggering warmpool prefetch to repopulate prefix cache.

jamal: after prefetch, p95 trending back down 130-150ms and 5xx rate normalizing. looks like the cache rebuild helped

lina: logging a root cause hypothesis on the release thread: quantize-v2 path + long-context traffic -> cache thrash and retries

alex: good catch. we'll hold canary at 30% for 30m then decide on ramp. release note to add: "Canary paused due to transient embed-route latency; pinned to previous version (v2.13) pending investigation."

maya: filing follow-up ticket for quantize-v2 investigation and kvcache telemetry improvements. tagging infra/serving

deploy-bot: Status: canary paused @30%, pinned=v2.13, alerts muted. will post if any new signals. :white_check_mark:
